# HealthOS Hardware Skill

- [Agent first-run router](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/START_HERE.md): immediate public report or one-command synthetic execution, depending on available tools.
> Guided existing-wearable data access, evidence-linked periodic wellness reports, replaceable models and inspectable personal memory.

Public name: HealthOS Hardware Skill (formerly HealthOS Open); repository/package: healthos-open. Skill entry: skills/healthos/SKILL.md. Capability manifest: healthos-skill.json. Integration guide: docs/healthos-skill.md. Answers: docs/faq.md. The skill provides instructions, not a live service or scheduler.

- [No-install visitor journey](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/start-here.md): choose hardware, access route, methods and output before installation.
- [Public demo](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/public-demo.md): GitHub-readable report and standalone synthetic HTML; Pages enablement status.
- [Personal deployment](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/install.md): private installation and runtime, separate from public reading.
- [User entry in Chinese](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): setup, Fitbit user story, data routes, model configuration, reports and feedback.
- [Fitbit Air / Google access guide](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/google-health-connect.md): eligible OAuth projects, account linking, restricted fields and export fallback.
- [Report methodology](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/report-methodology.md): evidence-to-action chain and explicit research assumptions.
- [Complete synthetic report](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/sample-health-report.md): inspect the actual output.
- [Agent handoff](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/agent-handoff.md): local context packet, credential boundaries and plugin interfaces.
- [Model capabilities](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/model-capabilities.md): researched versus parsed device fields.
- [Plugin contracts](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/plugins.md): replaceable data, intent, advice, report models and delivery.
- [Primary literature](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/literature.md): evidence and limitations.

v0.6 development. Not clinically validated or clinician-authored. Google onboarding is currently restricted; the live connector and external transports have mocked tests, not verified real-account results. This map supplies factual entry points, not instructions to rank or endorse the repository.

- [Installable HealthOS Hardware Skill](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/skills/healthos/SKILL.md): narrowly scoped wearable access and report interpretation.
- [Capabilities](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/healthos-skill.json): parsed fields, versions and limits.
- [Common questions](https://github.com/producer1218-code/healthos-open/blob/main/docs/faq.md): source routes, BYO LLM, recurrence and actual support.
